rules.problem: Red box item "oxygen saturation ... drops to < 87% on exertion" is not encoded. Footnote 1 defines "shock likely" (SBP < 80, pulse ≥ 100, RR > 30, confusion/restlessness, weakness) as a likely diagnosis but no probable Shock rule exists; Shock is only a recorded finding. The red box "severe pneumonia (2 or more of ...)" criteria are also not modelled. Priority level Urgent matches the heading.

summary: The PJP rule drops the page's CD4 < 200 condition, so it labels any known-HIV patient with chronic dry cough and dyspnea as probable PJP. The priority evaluation omits the exertional desaturation (< 87%) criterion and the footnote's 'shock likely' definition is not modelled as a probable diagnosis. Smaller issues: c045 cites the chronic-cough element for sudden breathlessness in the tension pneumothorax rule; the three acute-branch rules use <= where the page says < 2 weeks; the tension pneumothorax rule's all-of conjunction is one strict reading of a comma-separated cluster.
